title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Late Charge and Collection Referral Figures
content:
**Credit and collections schedule — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** One schedule serves all six accommodation tiers.

| Figure | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Late charge rate | 1.5 percent per month of the past-due room-and-board balance |
| Grace period after the due date before a month is past due for late charges | 30 calendar days |
| Smallest past-due balance on which a late charge is assessed | USD 50.00 |
| What the late charge is computed on | Past-due room and board only — never fees, never earlier late charges |
| Late charges per agreement per calendar month | At most 1 |
| Late charge while the stay is converted to a pending or approved Medicaid payer source | None assessed |
| Days a balance must be past due before referral to the outside collection agency | 120 |
| Smallest past-due balance referred to collections | USD 250.00 |

**Hypothetical figure.** A past-due room-and-board balance of 2,200.00 at 1.5 percent per month gives a late charge of 33.00. A past-due room-and-board balance of 49.00 is below the 50.00 minimum and draws no late charge.
